skill.name: set-up-magento-google-ads-new-customer-bidding
skill.description: Set up Google Ads bidding for first paid orders from Magento or Adobe Commerce with Product Metrics. Verify tracking and choose between first-order revenue and profit before changing campaign goals.
skill.summary: Use first-order revenue or profit from Magento to guide new customer bidding in Google Ads.
skill.author: product-metrics

security_audit.summary: Most alerts match Markdown, normal setup steps, or instructions to protect a private key. The installation guidance runs an unpinned installer and adds an external package source to Magento. The workflow also lacks explicit limits on setup changes, order data access, and unrelated credentials; no evidence of prompt injection or covert exfiltration was found.

remediation.issue: The installation instructions use an unpinned installer and an unpinned skill source.
remediation.suggestion: Pin the installer and skill to reviewed releases or immutable revisions. Provide a way to verify integrity and require approval before execution.

remediation.issue: The Magento installation adds an external Composer repository.
remediation.suggestion: Have a developer verify the repository and package integrity before installation. Limit repository resolution to Product Metrics packages and validate the change in staging.

remediation.issue: Prerequisite setup can exceed the requested campaign scope.
remediation.suggestion: Show the selected account, store view, data destinations, and planned changes before any write. Require separate approval for additional channels or audience uploads.

remediation.issue: Order checks do not state what data the assistant may retrieve or display.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the workspace and store view before querying orders. Use the smallest necessary sample and return classifications or aggregates without customer identifiers.

remediation.issue: General instructions allow the assistant to relay credentials unrelated to this workflow.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the unrelated exceptions. Use vendor-controlled authorization or a secure credential field, and keep credentials out of chat and command arguments.

content.user_title: Set Up New Customer Bidding for Magento in Google Ads
content.value_statement: Standard purchase conversions do not distinguish first-time buyers from returning customers. This skill uses Product Metrics to verify first-order conversion signals and guide your Google Ads bidding setup.
actual_capabilities: Check the Product Metrics setup status for a Magento store view and Google Ads property.
Review scoped orders to see whether Product Metrics classifies them as new, returning, or unknown.
Identify the Google Ads conversion actions for first-order revenue and profit.
Guide the account owner through selecting a bidding goal and verify the resulting conversion action status.
Check whether a paid test order arrived after Magento cron ran.
limitations: A developer must install the Product Metrics Magento module. A workspace admin must connect Google Ads and Merchant Center.
The skill does not change the primary conversion action or campaign bidding goal for you.
Customer history is limited to one store view. Orders without an account or guest email cannot be classified.
Profit signals require complete costs and active additional costs. This workflow does not cover returning-customer or lifetime value bidding.

use_cases.title: Check first-order tracking
use_cases.description: Review setup status and confirm that a paid test order appears as a new customer before using it for bidding.

use_cases.title: Choose a goal for one campaign
use_cases.description: Compare first-order revenue and profit, then plan a campaign-specific goal that leaves other campaigns on their current goals.

use_cases.title: Diagnose missing test conversions
use_cases.description: Check the connected store view, configuration status, cron schedule, and consent settings before retesting.

prompt_templates.title: Check whether tracking is ready
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether my Magento store view is ready for new customer bidding. Confirm the store view and Google Ads account before checking. Do not change settings.

prompt_templates.title: Verify recent order classifications
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize how my last 20 paid Magento orders were classified in the confirmed store view. Give counts only and omit customer identifiers.

prompt_templates.title: Compare revenue and profit
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare first-order revenue and profit for my campaign. Check whether costs are complete and show which conversion action I would choose for each option.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a rollout for one campaign
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: limit the scope of a bidding change
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan first-order bidding for one Google Ads campaign. Include the manual goal change, a target ROAS check, and a paid test order. Leave other campaigns unchanged.

output_examples.input: Did the test order arrive as a new customer?
output: Product Metrics received the paid test order after Magento cron ran.
The order is classified as new for this store view.
The first-order revenue action is still secondary. No bidding settings changed.

output_examples.input: Why is the new customer profit action empty?
output: First-order revenue is arriving, but additional costs are not active.
Activate additional costs and check that the next paid test order has complete cost data.
Keep the current bidding goal until you verify a profit conversion.

output_examples.input: How do I test first-order bidding without changing other campaigns?
output: Use a campaign-specific goal for the test campaign and select Product Metrics - New Customer for first-order revenue.
Keep the existing goals for other campaigns. After you make the change, verify the selected goal and target ROAS.

best_practices: Confirm the Magento store view and Google Ads client account before connecting services or reading orders.
Verify consent and use a guest test order in payment test mode before changing a campaign goal.
Start with one campaign and keep one primary purchase action in the relevant goal.
anti_patterns: Treating a customer who switches store views as a returning customer across the entire Magento installation.
Making both revenue and profit actions primary for the same goal.
Sharing a private Magento configuration file or customer identifiers in chat.

faq.question: Do I need Product Metrics and a developer?
faq.answer: Yes. A developer installs the Product Metrics Magento module and configures cron. Connect each store view you want to track.

faq.question: Do I need Merchant Center?
faq.answer: Yes. Link Merchant Center to the Google Ads client account that runs your campaigns, then connect it in Product Metrics.

faq.question: How does Magento decide whether a customer is new?
faq.answer: Product Metrics checks for earlier paid orders in the same store view by customer account or guest email. Cancelled orders do not count.

faq.question: What if an order has no account or guest email?
faq.answer: Product Metrics cannot classify the customer as new or returning. The order can still contribute to standard revenue or profit conversions.

faq.question: Why can revenue appear when profit is missing?
faq.answer: The profit action requires complete order costs and active additional costs. Orders with unknown costs can still send revenue.

faq.question: Will setup change my campaign bidding automatically?
faq.answer: No. Product Metrics creates conversion actions as secondary. You choose the primary action or campaign-specific goal in Google Ads.
